Theorem
[Gromoll–Meyer injectivity-radius estimate] Source: cao-zhu 1. Theorem 4.2.1\group Cao–Zhu Injectivity Radius Estimates \index{Gromoll-Meyer injectivity radius estimate} Let $M$ be a complete, noncompact Riemannian manifold with positive sectional curvature. Then the injectivity radius of $M$ satisfies the following estimate \[ {\rm inj}\, (M)\geq \frac{\pi }{\sqrt{K_{\max }}}. \]
